correctness.rationale: The finite all-pairs base and 4-residue lift identities were independently tested across all 15 unequal cases. The base-and-lift induction proves saturation for every positive distance. Complete-block decomposition expresses any length 4q+r ones count through two endpoint letters; saturation supplies every endpoint choice for q>=1. The extrema and sliding-window continuity yield exact abelian complexities, and periodic equal-image cases are immediate. The standalone checker passed 1152 finite instances but is not the infinite proof.
